name: atera
description: Read Atera device inventory, monitor status, patch availability, and alerts through Rizonetech's local MCP integration.

interface.longDescription: Inspect endpoint agents and SNMP, TCP, HTTP, and generic monitors. Review open alerts, investigate individual devices, read installed or available patches, and summarize endpoint health with explicit pagination coverage. Read-only tools use your Atera API token from a Windows account-encrypted local credential, with optional 1Password reference mode. Independently developed by Rizonetech; not an official Atera product.
defaultPrompt: Summarize endpoint health and open alerts in Atera, showing scan coverage.
Find this device in Atera and inspect its monitoring status.
Review available patches for an Atera device.
